problem_type: Clip node canvas export completes without user feedback
symptom: Release Candidate run 35846678730 generated a successful MP4 for clip-node-editing, but the real journey timed out waiting for the success notification after exporting to canvas.
direct_cause: ClipNode reported completion only for download exports; the canvas destination created nodes and edges but never called the shared inline feedback owner.
class_root: Every completed clip export destination must report its result through the ClipNode feedback owner after the project write has completed.
affected_population: Clip node users exporting a full cut to canvas
Clip node users exporting independent segments to canvas
internal_only_reason: The missing notification is an application-owned feedback contract observed by the real Nomi journey; no third-party behavior decides whether a destination completed.

invariant_owner_layer.why: ClipNode owns both export destinations and the inline feedback state, so the completion message belongs immediately after the shared destination branch.

invariants: A successful canvas export reports its completed node count through ClipNode feedback.
A successful download export retains its existing file count feedback.
Failures continue through the existing shared export failure feedback path.

door_reduction.why_not: The other export handlers are separate surfaces with separate owners; only ClipNode's shared handleExport completion branch is changed.

generality_proof: Both full and independent-segment canvas/download exports already converge on the existing ClipNode journey assertion; the product fix adds the missing canvas feedback at the shared completion boundary without changing the established real journey contract.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Report a destination-specific success message after all export tasks and canvas writes complete.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The shared completion branch now reports the completed node count for canvas destination.
The same branch preserves the existing download file count message.

recurrence.reason: Any future export destination branch can complete work while omitting user feedback unless the shared completion boundary reports every destination.
same_class_scan: Checked full and independent-segment canvas/download calls in tests/ux/clip-node-editing.walk.mjs
RC run 35846678730 diagnostics showed export status succeeded and the expected canvas toast never appeared

prevention.invariant: Every successful ClipNode export destination reports completion after its writes finish.
prevention.failure_mode: The real journey waits for the destination-specific feedback and fails if it is absent; export failures remain visible through the existing error message.
prevention.strategy: Use one destination-specific reportFeedback call after the shared completion branch instead of adding notification calls inside each export loop.

legacy_paths.rationale: No export destination or feedback path is removed; the missing canvas completion message is added to the existing owner.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency controls feedback delivery or export completion.

migration: No persisted state migration is needed; the new strings are read through the existing i18n resources.
residual_risks: The repaired RC must rerun the clip-node journey and all packaging jobs before stable promotion.
